summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature in the repository without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning is_terminal as a bool and buffering the control; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one branch calling term.set_title(title); tests added in tests/test_console.py (skips when console.legacy_windows), tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py (Windows-only); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Not run: tests, Black, and mypy were not executed per instructions, so everything is verified by reading only.
